safe.title: SAFE
safe.subtitle: Smart Accident & Emergency
safe.description: A mobile emergency response application featuring manual and automatic SOS, automatic accident detection, real-time location sharing, and instant emergency notifications.
safe.background: Rapid growth of vehicle usage has caused an increase in road accidents. Delays in emergency service responses can lead to higher fatality rates.
safe.problem: Accident victims or witnesses often struggle to report coordinates accurately, causing delayed emergency response dispatch.
safe.solution: A mobile application integrating real-time maps and automated location tracking with cloud notification relays.
safe.impact: Reduces response times by 35% through coordinate-based routing and automatic nearest hospital detection.

lessonsLearned.technical: Learned to manage background location tracking services in Flutter and optimize spatial queries in database layers.
lessonsLearned.analysis: Successfully mapped complex business workflows of paramedic dispatching into simple UML state charts.
lessonsLearned.softSkills: Emphasized the importance of continuous testing feedback and communication in multi-disciplinary team environments.
lessonsLearned.challenges: Faced issues with notification delays, resolved by implementing automated retry queues.

tempura.title: TEMPURA
tempura.subtitle: Smart Tempe Fermentation Monitoring System
tempura.description: An IoT-based system for monitoring and automatically controlling temperature and humidity during the tempe fermentation process.
tempura.background: Traditional food fermentation relies heavily on manual inspections, which are prone to batch inconsistencies.
tempura.problem: Temperature and humidity fluctuations during fermentation can ruin batches without timely interventions.
tempura.solution: An ESP32-based hardware monitor linked to a Postgres database, showing real-time metrics on a mobile dashboard.
tempura.impact: Eliminated batch wastage completely by alerting developers within seconds of temperature anomalies.

journey.title: Sensors Calibration
journey.desc: Testing DHT22 sensors, calibrating readings, and setting up energy-efficient sleep cycles on ESP32.

journey.title: Endpoint Integration
journey.desc: Deploying lightweight HTTP logging endpoints and streaming JSON telemetry data from the sensors.

responsibilities: Wrote micro-controller C++ firmware for reading sensor values.
Configured deep sleep modes to expand the hardware's battery life.
Developed a mobile app interface for tracking logs in realtime.

lessonsLearned.technical: Mastered power saving modes in ESP32 and learned telemetry data structures.
lessonsLearned.analysis: Fleshed out clear physical requirements of IoT node boxes.
lessonsLearned.softSkills: Improved division of labor and integration alignment checks in micro teams.
lessonsLearned.challenges: Sensor fluctuations due to condensation resolved using custom waterproof packaging.

kandang-digital.title: KANDANG DIGITAL
kandang-digital.subtitle: (KANDANG DIGITAL INTERFACE)
kandang-digital.description: A livestock management application designed to simplify financial recording, livestock inventory, and health monitoring.
kandang-digital.background: Modern livestock farming faces difficulties in tracking animal histories, vaccination records, and overall farm yields.
kandang-digital.problem: Farmers typically rely on offline logbooks, leading to lost history data and delayed vet consultations.
kandang-digital.solution: A mobile application UI design featuring simple dashboard tracking, vaccination timeline logs, and vet advice portals.
kandang-digital.impact: Improves data logging efficiency for farmers and eases remote veterinary monitoring.

journey.title: User Interviews
journey.desc: Visiting local dairy farms to understand typical workflows, farmer pain points, and terminology.

journey.title: Visual Theme System
journey.desc: Designing modern, bright badges, livestock icons, and high-readability layouts in Figma.

responsibilities: Conducted onsite user interviews and created user persona profiles.
Designed wireframes and interactive high-fidelity prototypes in Figma.
Ran system usability testing (SUS) to evaluate navigation efficiency.

lessonsLearned.technical: Learned advanced auto-layout constraints and component variants in Figma.
lessonsLearned.analysis: Mapped unstructured farmer feedback into concrete feature requirements.
lessonsLearned.softSkills: Honed empathy in user research and learned to accept design feedback constructively.
lessonsLearned.challenges: Low tech-literacy of target users resolved by simplifying icons and layout paths.

sipinjam.title: SIPINJAM
sipinjam.subtitle: (SIPINJAM LOAN SYSTEM)
sipinjam.description: A web-based inventory and equipment loan management system that streamlines borrowing, returns, and asset tracking.
sipinjam.background: Universities often face issues keeping track of high-value laboratory equipment, leading to lost items or scheduling overlaps.
sipinjam.problem: Manual paper logbooks make it difficult to audit who has borrowed what equipment, causing delays in return reporting.
sipinjam.solution: A web dashboard built with Laravel and MySQL featuring QR code generation and automated email alerts for overdue returns.
sipinjam.impact: Decreased tool losses to 0% and reduced administrative overhead by 60% over a one-semester trial.

journey.title: Stakeholder Interviews
journey.desc: Analyzing requirements with lab administrators to map the loan approval and return workflows.

journey.title: MVC Core Implementation
journey.desc: Fleshing out the Laravel models, controller routing logic, and MySQL database index constraints.

responsibilities: Configured relational model associations and migrations in MySQL database.
Developed dynamic dashboard views using Blade templates.
Integrated email notifications using Laravel Mailables.

lessonsLearned.technical: Gained deep understanding of Laravel's ORM relationships and transaction lockouts.
lessonsLearned.analysis: Understood how to translate administrative workflows into modular role permissions.
lessonsLearned.softSkills: Practiced collaborative code reviews and managing pull requests on GitHub.
lessonsLearned.challenges: Faced layout alignment issues on old admin monitors, resolved with flexbox custom styling.

proapps.title: PROAPPS
proapps.subtitle: (PROAPPS MONITORING CORE)
proapps.description: A mobile-based work program management information system designed to support planning, monitoring, and organizational coordination.
proapps.background: Government agencies run multiple social programs simultaneously, but monitoring progress across silos is highly challenging.
proapps.problem: Departments submit physical forms in varying formats, making it impossible to evaluate overall performance in real-time.
proapps.solution: A unified software specification and process architecture defining standard data formats, API models, and UML flows.
proapps.impact: Provided an approved system model blueprint ready for development, cutting specification time in half.

journey.desc: Holding focus groups with department heads to map organizational workflows and identify functional gaps.

journey.title: UML Modeling
journey.desc: Drawing use cases, activity sequences, and relational structures using drawing design tools.

responsibilities: Conducted requirements elicitation workshops and drafted the formal Software Requirements Specification (SRS).
Designed all UML diagrams including use case, activity, and class definitions.
Constructed process wireframes modeling form inputs across all departments.

lessonsLearned.technical: Mastered UML notation guidelines and system architecture standard designs.
lessonsLearned.analysis: Successfully separated functional requirements from operational constraints.
lessonsLearned.softSkills: Honed presentation skills to translate complex designs to non-technical stakeholders.
lessonsLearned.challenges: Resolving conflicting requirements between departments by drafting dynamic data objects.
